narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On April 4, 2024, at approximately 1310 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a landscaping supply yard in Novi, Michigan, while following up on a tip about unauthorized workers. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no papers that allow him to live or work in the United States.
ENTRY AND TRAVEL:
The subject said he has crossed the border three times. The first time was in 2008, when he was a teenager; he was caught near Nogales and sent back the same day. The second time, in 2012, he stayed about a year in Phoenix before going home on his own for his father's funeral.
The subject stated that his most recent crossing was in the summer of 2017, when he walked through the hills east of Nogales, Arizona, with a guide, and that he has not left the United States since then.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Warrant of Arrest and Notice to Appear.
